column.description:
Resources like Entry can have schemas associated with them. This scope allows users to attach tags to an
individual column based on that schema.

For attaching a tag to a nested column, use '.' to separate the column names. Example:
'outer_column.inner_column'
column.rationale: This is a user-defined column reference for metadata tagging and does not control access to the column data.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

parent.description:
The name of the parent this tag is attached to. This can be the name of an entry or an entry group. If an entry group, the tag will be attached to
all entries in that group.
parent.rationale: This is a user-defined resource reference and does not by itself control access to the underlying resource or data.

template.rationale: This is a user-defined resource reference and does not by itself control access to the underlying resource or data.

fields.description:
This maps the ID of a tag field to the value of and additional information about that field.
Valid field IDs are defined by the tag's template. A tag must have at least 1 field and at most 500 fields.

fields.bool_value.description: Holds the value for a tag field with boolean type.
fields.bool_value.rationale: This is a metadata value stored in the tag field and does not directly enforce security.

fields.double_value.description: Holds the value for a tag field with double type.
fields.double_value.rationale: This is a metadata value stored in the tag field and does not directly enforce security.

fields.enum_value.description: The display name of the enum value.
fields.enum_value.rationale: This is a metadata value stored in the tag field and does not directly enforce security.

fields.field_name.description: The identifier for this object. Format specified above.
fields.field_name.rationale: This is a user-defined identifier and does not control access to the resource or data.

fields.string_value.description: Holds the value for a tag field with string type.
fields.string_value.rationale: This is a metadata value stored in the tag field and does not directly enforce security.

fields.timestamp_value.description: Holds the value for a tag field with timestamp type.
fields.timestamp_value.rationale: This is a metadata value stored in the tag field and does not directly enforce security.
